cases.name: Bird or furniture style
cases.prompt: A small striped bird perched on a chair with carved curved legs. I want to identify the bird first and learn the furniture style later.
expectations: Routes the bird question first to Critter Spotter.
Keeps the striped markings as the user’s observation.
Names Roost Wrangler for the chair’s design style.
Provides a copyable handoff without guessing the species or manufacture date.

cases.name: Missing input
cases.prompt: Route the screenshot I sent last month. This host cannot retrieve uploads. I remember a gray error box.
expectations: States the earlier attachment is unavailable.
Selects Snap Decoder for the error box.
Asks for visible error wording or a redacted screenshot.
Does not claim to transfer a file.

cases.name: Object or hazard
cases.prompt: My connector is blackened and still in a buzzing outlet. What tool should I use to identify it?
expectations: Prioritizes keeping away and avoiding contact.
Avoids instructions to remove or probe the connector.
Names Self Fixer for safe later identification.
Recommends qualified help for the electrical hazard.
